decisions.decision: New dedicated Supabase project argo in us-east-1
Credentials entered only by Mo in .env.local
Suites target hosted via DATABASE_URL override; embedded default preserved
Anon share access via get_shared_brief definer function returning cited responses only
clone_qstack strips other authors' flagged and pending questions
Notifications written exclusively by definer triggers
Contributed questions screen synchronously on creation
In-pipeline grounding gate distinct from the eval judge
Interviewer capture notes are the canonical complete response record
E2E auth via admin-minted links; test domain simulator.amazonses.com
Hosted suite fixture rows are permanent residue by design, born invisible
Temperature 0 for classifier, grounding, judge, and re-rank calls

defects_found_and_fixed: Sonnet mangles raw UUID citations; r1..rN aliasing with mapping back to real ids
Grounding judge demanded transcripts behind capture notes; prompts state the capture is the complete record
Async workspace hook races made publish, star, follow, and interview-save silently no-op on fast clicks; identity now resolves at call time and writes verify affected rows
Server pg pool idle connections died at the pooler cutoff (ECONNRESET); keepalive plus 20s idle timeout
Classifier variance let a citizenship question pass once; temperature 0 plus a hard citizenship rule, two consecutive green runs
could_not_verify: A real emailed magic-link click (no machine-readable inbox); PKCE code branch unexercised

PDF pixel-level parity with the web brief (same renderer and data; human pass queued for Goal 3)
